summary: The full 150-row Step 1 requirement set is tier-assigned and protected by machine-checkable metadata enforcement, static evidence consistency gates, fail-closed hardening, and CI workflows. This does not claim real replay execution, real OTEL emission, full production runtime proof, or full architecture proof.

tier6_split_mode.must_rows_policy: Normal static evidence consistency checks (code/validator/test/artifact/replay/negative-control/OTEL refs exist on disk; artifact + replay JSONs match step1_req_id / expected_fail_reason; replay pairs share invariant_digest).
tier6_split_mode.reference_only_rows_policy: Reference-only policy contract (release_gate_rule=NON_BLOCKING_REFERENCE, requirement_strength=REFERENCE, policy artifact membership). Reference-only rows do not claim runtime proof. No real replay execution, no real OTEL emission, no runtime proof claim for these rows.

ci_workflows_note: Tier 0-2 metadata-gate workflows exist (tier0/1/2-enforcement-gate.yml). Tier 3-6 metadata-gate CI is invoked transitively by tier3/4/5/6-runtime-proof-gate.yml (the runtime-proof verifier subprocess-runs the metadata gate). The master all-requirements-gate.yml also runs every metadata gate.
caveats: No full pytest run is performed by any gate.
